environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 application deployed on a Linux VM (Ubuntu 22.04) behind an NGINX reverse proxy. The application runs as www-data user with write access to /var/app/uploads/extracted and /var/app/wwwroot/js. Static files are served directly by Kestrel with UseStaticFiles() middleware. The _Layout.cshtml references plugin scripts with integrity attributes, but the application also dynamically injects script tags via a TagHelper that reads from a plugins.json manifest WITHOUT integrity attributes for dynamically loaded plugins. NGINX is configured with proxy_pass only, no content filtering.

config.static_file_serving: Kestrel UseStaticFiles with no content hash validation
config.dynamic_script_loading: TagHelper injects plugin scripts without SRI for dynamic plugins
